tips.title: Low Session Frequency
tips.description: Your sessions are infrequent. Regular consistent sessions can help build better patterns and outcomes.

tips.title: Session Success Rate Below 50%
tips.description: Consider breaking down complex tasks into smaller sessions and using more comprehensive planning before execution.

tips.title: Use Specialized Agents
tips.description: Consider using specialized agents like unified-coverage-agent, ci-failure-resolution-agent, or autonomous-test-healer-agent for focused improvements.
